Hi, Nick, your prescription for 15mg was sent to CVS. [Name redacted] NP

Hey [Name redacted], Thanks. My health plan is refusing to give me a ride to the pharmacy so I need to figure something out. I made a complaint to the Ombudsman. And regarding the payment tomorrow... I'll make it happen. I appreciate the 30 day grace period we discussed but I'll handle it no worries. - Nick
